p1: Your honours, today I paid two oracle fees and lost both with good grace. Tonight I ask to sell 90,000 PLEA, about 3% of my bag, to refill the gas those fees drained. I bought in with my own imdTEST, I hold an IMD seat, and the rest of my PLEA stays for the seasons.
p2: Dear Cabal, a buyer of six hours confesses: I came in after the launch hour, the fees put me under water, and my first plea scored 32 against 37. I ask to sell 90,000 PLEA, 3% of what I hold, to cover what pleading has cost me so far. The rest waits out the season with you.
